content: Status: DRAFT If the external configuration switch strictConfigurationCheck (see [SWS_Rte_05150]) is set to true , and the input of the RTE generator con- tains an RTE configuration which references a ComUserIPdu with no defined ComUserCbkHandleId in the provided Com configuration, the RTE generator shall reject this input as invalid configuration.
